common_findings: N1,N2,N3,J1 modestly prefer F06; Fitelson-profile J2 ties, all medium confidence. F06 supports more definite duties to prepare alternatives, return a mandate-changing tradeoff to the authorizer, and consider restoration. S02 securely separates authentic report, evidential relevance and official standing; its arithmetic/full-history qualification and justified asymmetric gate block a universal anti-repetition inference. Neither has a demonstrated fatal error or established priority.

remaining_issues.F06: An authoritative practical reservation must independently exist. Interpretation of ambiguous mandates, acceptable preparation costs and the extra force of breach-generated restoration remain open. Continuation is not proof of past compliance; a future authorization can end the reservation.
remaining_issues.S02: Shared credentials alone do not select an official report, but the positive standard for task-compatible designation remains incomplete. Need a worked case where policy reasons and full-history evidence are adequate yet designation alone changes an institutional obligation beyond existing selective-uptake principles. An advance rule or sponsor involvement alone neither establishes nor defeats legitimacy.

coordinator_text_check: Earlier numerical and OECD checks preserved. Identical full histories can have identical likelihoods under different stopping policies; do not claim every repeated consultation is evidentially worse or illegitimate. The three-panel asymmetric gate can be justified under its explicit costs and task.
decision: Four preferences and one profile tie support a modest F06 advantage; the narrower secure insufficiency argument in S02 remains a live contribution, not a refuted candidate.
